Hi Sanjay / Priyanka,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion and helpful context on the three primary use cases you want to validate (note classification, response synthesis for patient Q&A, and records embedding for search). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock down the evaluation kickoff: 

Recap (from our notes):
- Primary success criteria: 85%+ accuracy on note categorization test set; sub-500ms 95th percentile latency for short prompts; embeddings recall >= 0.78 on subset.
- Data scope: de-identified clinical notes + synthetic patient messages for prompt evaluation.
- Security asks: SOC 2 evidence requested, plus vendor data retention policy.

Proposed evaluation kickoff (60–75 min):
1) Introductions & objectives (5)
2) Trial plan walkthrough (timeline, environments, roles) (15)
3) Prompt set & evals — handoff and example prompts (20)
4) Technical deep dive: network/endpoint, model variants, quantization options (15)
5) Next steps & action owners (5)

Attachments: HS-trial-plan-v1.pdf (trial timeline + roles) and healthsync-prompt-template.csv (prompt template + example eval rows).

Can you share two windows next week that work for a 60–75 minute kickoff? To speed scheduling, here is a Calendly link with our availability: https://calendly.com/redwood/45min-eval-kickoff (we can extend to 75 if needed).

Also, please confirm the internal stakeholders who should be on the kickoff (the ones you mentioned: Priyanka — ML lead; Alex — CTO; security contact). If you want Redwood to include a focused technical engineer for model runtime/latency discussion, I’ll CC Aditya and Marissa on follow-ups.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
